in_sanskrit.name: गणपति
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who leads or protects the Ganas (groups). Gana can mean a group, a community or a multitude of beings.

in_hindi.name: गणपत
in_hindi.meaning: प्रभवती शक्ति के साथ सबका पति
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who leads or protects all, with the power of the primal energy (Prakriti or Shakti).

in_tamil.name: கணபதி
in_tamil.meaning: குழந்தையிடம் அவ்வாற்றுக்கள் ஆயிர்த்தல் கோவில் இல்லையில் வாழ்வது
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who resides in the heart and protects all beings that do not have a temple or a dwelling.

in_telugu.name: గణపత
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who leads or guides every being.

in_marathi.name: Ganpat
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Ganas (groups)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ganpat हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ganapat is a Sanskrit name meaning 'Lord of Ganas'. In Hindu mythology, Ganesha is the elephant-headed god, who is the lord of beginnings, wisdom, and remover of obstacles.

in_bengali.name: Ganpat
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of Ganas (groups)
in_bengali.long_meaning: Ganpat একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Ganapat is a Sanskrit name meaning 'Lord of Ganas'. In Hindu mythology, Ganesha is the elephant-headed god, who is the lord of beginnings, wisdom, and remover of obstacles.
